register.labelZh: SETTLE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: settle down 可以表示舒適地坐下,也可以表示變得平靜;settle somebody down 則表示令另一個人平靜下來。；朋友分賬、有人代購門票,或旅程後仍有款項未付時,都可以使用 settle up。；settle for 表示原本想要的選擇無法得到,因此接受一個不完全符合心意的選擇。；settle to 表示開始專心工作;settle upon 表示考慮後作出選擇;settle something on somebody 則表示正式把金錢或財產留給某人。
register.summaryEn: Settle down can describe making yourself comfortable or becoming calm. Settle somebody down shows that one person helps another person become calm. Settle up is useful when friends share a bill, someone has bought tickets for a group, or money is still owed after a trip. Settle for shows that the first choice was unavailable and a person accepted something that was not quite what they wanted. Settle to describes beginning to focus on work. Settle upon describes choosing after consideration. Settle something on somebody describes formally giving money or property.
